definitions.explanation: A position of strength or dominance, almost always used figuratively for an organization, industry, or territory that is firmly controlled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牙城|がじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧。
examples.english: To topple the stronghold of the industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牙城|がじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}いた→築く：02046_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: That company built a stronghold in this field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新興|しんこう}→新興：00457_shinkou⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参入|さんにゅう}→参入：09939_sannyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{守|まも}って→守る：01986_mamoru⟧きた{牙城|がじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに⟦{揺|ゆ}らぎ→揺らぐ：07601_yuragu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: With the entry of emerging manufacturers, the stronghold that the major companies had defended for years finally began to waver.

notes:
Originally referred to the innermost tower of a castle where the commander resides (⟦{牙|きば}→牙：16154_kiba⟧ refers to a general's flag/standard + ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧ castle). Now used almost exclusively in a figurative sense for a dominant position in business, politics, or competition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牙城|がじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧: to topple a stronghold
- {牙城|がじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧: to build a stronghold
- {牙城|がじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to defend a stronghold
- {牙城|がじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脅|おびや}かす→脅かす：13942_obiyakasu⟧: to threaten a stronghold
- {難攻不落|なんこうふらく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牙城|がじょう}: an impregnable stronghold

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{拠点|きょてん}→拠点：05628_kyoten⟧: base, strongpoint — more neutral, practical
- ⟦{砦|とりで}→砦：24127_toride⟧: fortress, bastion — can be literal or figurative
- ⟦{本丸|ほんまる}→本丸：24197_honmaru⟧: main keep, core territory — also figurative for the heart of something
